1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced six inches apart to forty-eight inches apart.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced sixteen inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

5. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, and the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening that has a size range of not less than two inches square to not more than twelve inches square.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that can be removed for maintenance.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall, and wherein the housing is designed to accommodate structural integrity.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements that allow positioning within the wall; and a ventilation grill that is adjustable. 

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: a mounting structure installable within a structure wall, the mounting structure configured to house an evaporative cooling system for cooling an indoor area. 

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the mounting structure includes brackets designed for securing the evaporative cooling system between wall studs spaced sixteen inches on center.
